purpose: Frame the next safe backlog v0.5 move after S36-S39 without treating two heterogeneous S28/S29 usage records as expansion evidence.

completed_cycle.name: post-s33-domain-governance-usage-cycle
completed_cycle.accepted_outcome: S28/S29 remain usable as manual advisory guidance; expansion is blocked until more comparable real usage evidence exists.

domain_governance_expansion.reason: S39 found only two real usage records, and they are too heterogeneous for reusable controls, automation, success rates or security-proof claims.
domain_governance_expansion.reopen_condition: Another real Work Slice meets S37 entry criteria and is captured with S35; repeated comparable records then justify a new sufficiency review.

s18_comparative_work_metrics.reason: The current five Work Observatory records do not share one reviewed stable comparison group.
s18_comparative_work_metrics.reopen_condition: At least five reviewed records sharing one stable comparison_group plus explicit comparison-validity and privacy review.

runtime_2_0_implementation.reason: ADR-016 keeps Runtime 2.0 as a strategic north-star and boundary-review source, not an implementation authorization.
runtime_2_0_implementation.reopen_condition: Later explicit boundary decision with repeated evidence proving a missing execution interface.

observatory_or_policy_automation.reason: No current review proves a need for collectors, dashboards, scanners, policy engines, schemas or enforcement.
observatory_or_policy_automation.reopen_condition: Source-backed repeated manual failures that cannot be handled by existing advisory contracts.

candidate_next_tracks.why: SYSTEM_STATE explicitly tracks CHANGELOG and first-use guide coherence as not assessed by S15, and cognitive debt remains medium; this can improve understanding without adding runtime or enforcement.
non_goals: mandatory ceremony for every Lite slice
evidence_needed: source-backed comparison of README, CHANGELOG, SYSTEM_STATE and first-use guide
bounded doc corrections only if necessary

candidate_next_tracks.why: S28/S29 should be applied only when a real Work Slice involves agent, prompt-injection, untrusted-content, web/API, auth, tenant, secrets or trust-boundary concerns.
S18 remains blocked because existing records are heterogeneous.
evidence_needed: five comparable reviewed records in one stable comparison group

decision.next_slice: S41 documentation and first-use coherence review
decision.rationale: After S39, the safest backlog progress is to reduce cognitive debt and documentation mismatch risk, not to expand domain governance or reopen deferred infrastructure tracks.
